title: How many male customers who were born between 1974 and 1976 have made a pay
question:
How many male customers who were born between 1974 and 1976 have made a payment on their home in excess of $4000?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Man and male refers to gender = 'M'; 'SIPO' stands for household payment

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_009) AS customer_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
JOIN "order" o ON d.XCL_015 = o.XCL_041
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'M'
  AND c.XCL_011 BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND o.XCL_045 = 'SIPO'
  AND o.XCL_044 > 4000;
